title: Lesson 4: Reverse Proxy & API Gateway — js-tools
desc: TLS termination and the truth about X-Forwarded-For; real measurements show TLS costs only ~10% with keep-alive but grows to nearly 16x when every request opens a new connection; a static-file measurement that goes against prediction — the gateway is 2.6x slower than proxying to Node until open_file_cache is added (2.4x faster); aggregating data in parallel takes 208 ms versus 386 ms sequential; and a timeout budget to avoid multiplying retries.
